scope: Original typed CSS math compilation from prebuilt syntax and raw numeric CPU resolution only. No property/cascade/CSSOM/layout/renderer/JS/network/UI/browser or Chrome performance evidence.

controls.folding: baseline-math-folding disables static-subtree/zero-relative-unit folding and sum normalization
controls.sums: baseline-math-sums preserves operator-order sums; static folding remains enabled
controls.default: type-checked static folding, canonical constant sums and bounded contextual programs

method: Three sequential CPU-0 runs per mode, order folding/sums/default then reversed then original; 2000 compiles and 20000 reused-scratch resolutions per case per run. Throughput figures are each run mean; summary takes median of three run means. First-call samples recorded independently. No concurrent checks started by this session during samples. Other load, clocks and thermals uncontrolled. Controls are counterfactual builds of these sources, not prior production revisions.
memory_accounting: Value/Vec capacities + unique Program headers/Arc reference counts + emitted instruction capacities; excludes allocator metadata, transient compiler spill and reusable resolution Scratch. RSS includes entire synthetic process and allocator retention. Static pool contains 10000 separately compiled values, not cloned Arcs.
caveats: Prebuilt CSS Syntax excludes lexical/source cost.
Short unresolved workloads show mixed throughput; no uniform speedup claim.
Canonical sum reassociation follows CSS Values 4 and can differ from ordered IEEE arithmetic at extreme magnitudes.
SIMD/GPU not introduced in this module; scalar type checking and folding avoid repeated work.
Scope of imported conformance evidence is documented separately in numeric-fixtures/README.md.
